data: Kagi News distills thousands of world-wide news sources into one perfect daily briefing. Get every critical perspective in just 5 minutes. No endless scrolling. No attention hijacking.
Meta description for category pages. {category} will be replaced with the actual category name.
World doesn't live in echo chambers. The reality emerges from the collision of different viewpoints and perspectives - that's how we separate signal from noise.
First paragraph of the approach section
We strive for diversity and transparency of resources and welcome your contributions to widen perspectives. This multi-source approach helps reveal the full picture beyond any single viewpoint.
Second paragraph of the approach section with GitHub link

Kagi News reads public RSS feeds of thousands of (community-curated) world-wide news sources and distills them into one perfect daily briefing. You get every critical perspective and timeline in just 5 minutes. That's it. No endless scrolling. No attention hijacking. Because we deserve better.
Third paragraph of the approach section
For feedback, please use Kagi Feedback. For support, support@kagi.com.
Personalize your feed by reordering and toggling categories in settings. Want to contribute? Most of Kagi News is open source, including our web app and community-curated feeds.
Description of customization options with GitHub link
One daily update (~noon UTC), creating a natural endpoint to your news consumption
First core principle about daily updates
Focus on facts and perspectives over opinions
Second core principle about facts vs opinions
Zero compromise on privacy - your reading habits are yours alone
Fifth core principle about time efficiency
Liberation from the attention economy - exist in the moment, not in an endless scroll

Driven by relentless ad monetization, news has become mental junk food - an endless stream of clickbait that destroys our ability to think deeply and clearly. We can do better, and create what news should have been all along - pure, essential information that respects your intelligence and time.

The World Tension index provides a temperature reading of global stability based on current events.
First paragraph of world tension explanation
By analyzing headlines from around the world, we track patterns of conflict, crisis, and instability to create a simple metric that shows how "heated" global affairs are at any given moment.
Second paragraph of world tension explanation
Think of it as a global thermometer - when tensions rise due to conflicts, disasters, or political turmoil, the temperature goes up. During calmer periods of stability and cooperation, it cools down.
